themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to public services, housing, and healthcare. This theme is particularly strong in Spain, Italy, and France, where parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Lega, and Rassemblement National are either implementing or advocating for such measures, often clashing with opposition and human rights groups.

themes.title: Trump’s policies dominate global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's domestic and foreign policies continue to shape right-wing narratives worldwide, with his influence extending beyond the U.S. to countries like Poland, Italy, Argentina, and France. Coverage focuses on his economic strategies, immigration policies, and diplomatic engagements, particularly his recent summit with China’s Xi Jinping and his stance on Taiwan and Iran.

themes.title: Corruption scandals rock far-right governments

themes.title: Far-right parties exploit immigration tensions
themes.blurb: Immigration remains a central issue for far-right parties across Europe, with leaders like Italy’s Matteo Salvini, France’s Jordan Bardella, and the UK’s Nigel Farage using it to rally support. These parties are pushing for stricter border controls, deportations, and policies that prioritize native populations, often framing immigration as a threat to national identity and security.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal party divisions
themes.blurb: Internal divisions are destabilizing right-wing parties in Poland, Italy, and Argentina, with leaders like Poland’s Jarosław Kaczyński, Italy’s Giorgia Meloni, and Argentina’s Javier Milei struggling to maintain unity. These divisions are fueled by policy disagreements, personal rivalries, and corruption scandals, threatening the stability of their governments.
